capability: A guess cannot fill an evidence slot
title: Hunches don't fit the slot.

hook.picture: Close on the whale beside a ship lever on the line. A pink speech card, 'looks fine', slides onto the lever and the lever drops.
hook.words: It looked fine in the chat.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: Someone said it looked fine, so the bot shipped it.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: release manager after a bad deploy

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: three ship levers along the line. A pink 'sounds right' card drops each one, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½. Pods ✕ downstream.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: A guess and a test look alike.

stakes.body: Releases ship on somebody's say-so, and afterwards nobody can tell what the ship decision actually rested on.

solution_hint: Let only real test results ship it.

metaphor.body: The ship lever sits behind a socket shaped for evidence. A pink guess card bounces off it, and only a green test card snaps in. Only then does the lever move.

steps.picture: Tabs colour in on every card: pink guess, green test result, navy action. A green socket appears in front of the lever.
steps.words: Each card now shows its kind.
steps.sound: Three tuned taps, one per tab colour

steps.picture: Push-in (z 1.28): the whale nudges the pink guess card into the green socket. Refused at the joint: rust ✕, a small shake, a drop. The lever stays up.
steps.words: Wrong kind of card. The lever stays.
steps.sound: A muted thud on the refusal

steps.picture: A green test card slides in and snaps with a clean click. Only now does the navy action card pass and the lever drop.
steps.words: Right kind fits. Then it ships.
steps.sound: A clean click, then the lever in tune

steps.picture: The socket rim glows teal around the green card. A tick lands on the line under the lever.

real_case.claim: JEV's coloured operad has five colours. Joining is defined only on a colour match, and a claim cannot occupy an evidence port.

source.title: manutej/jev README; Notion JEV × JAX × The Twenty

honest_limit.picture: Still. A pod paints a green tab onto a card whose inside lines are smudged rust (a test that never ran). It snaps in cleanly and the lever drops.
honest_limit.words: The pod wrote the label itself.

not_this.body: A matching label can still lie.

ending_pattern.body: The lever waits for evidence: the same lever ignores the speech card and moves only when a green test card seats.
ending_pattern.callback: The speech card that dropped the lever in bar 1 now bounces off. The lever moves only for a test card.

end_belief.body: Let only evidence pull the ship lever.

score_self.reason: The problem and the move read sound-off from lever + socket. Words are short. Risk: the socket refusal image overlaps Stitch-60, and "port" is a weak term for a lay viewer.
